mapper.insert: INSERT INTO games (started_at, ended_at, winner) VALUES (#{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{winner})
mapper.update: UPDATE games SET ended_at = #{endedAt}, winner = #{winner} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, started_at AS startedAt, ended_at AS endedAt, winner FROM games ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rounds (game_id, round_num, winner, played_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{roundNum}, #{winner}, #{playedAt})
INSERT INTO scores (game_id, player, score) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{player}, #{score})
mapper.select: SELECT winner AS player, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM games WHERE winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner ORDER BY wins DESC
SELECT game_id AS gameId, player, score FROM scores ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
